<title level="2" right="Creature 9">[Ashrin](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2716)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="CE" url="/Rules.aspx?ID=95" />
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Humanoid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=91" />
<trait label="Munavri" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=358" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown](/Sources.aspx?ID=210) pg. 38

**Perception** +15; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12)

**Languages**
[Abyssal](/Languages.aspx?ID=12), [Aklo](/Languages.aspx?ID=13), [Alghollthu](/Languages.aspx?ID=24), [Dwarven](/Languages.aspx?ID=3), [Munavri](/Languages.aspx?ID=68), [Undercommon](/Languages.aspx?ID=11); [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=37) 30 feet ([munavris](/Traits.aspx?ID=358) only)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +19, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +19, [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +21, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +15, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +17, [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) +19

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +2

**Dex** +6

**Con** +4

**Int** +6

**Wis** +0

**Cha** +0
</row>

**[Light Blindness](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=22)** 

**Items**
[expanded alchemist's tools](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2), _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=3)_, [_demon's knot_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2674), formula book

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 27 

**Fort** +17 

**Ref** +19 

**Will** +15 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 155

</row>

**Immunities**
[confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=5), [controlled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=6)

**Resistances**
[fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72) 5, [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) 9, [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126) 5

**Weaknesses**
[cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=375) 10, good 10, demon touched

**Demon Touched** Ashrin is a puppet of the [demon](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=28) Kaivirris. He's harmed by good damage as if he were a [fiend](/Traits.aspx?ID=70).

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
_dagger_ +20 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [versatile B](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)),
**Damage** 2d4+4 piercing

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
_dagger_ +20 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [thrown 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195), [versatile B](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)),
**Damage** 2d4+4 piercing

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
bomb +20 ([thrown 30 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195)),
**Damage** varies

**Fiendish Infusion** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Requirements** Ashrin has a free hand; **Effect** Ashrin Interacts to draw a bomb, then funnels abyssal energy from Kaivirris into that bomb. Until the end of Ashrin's turn, the bomb deals an extra 3d8 negative damage.

**Intuit Object** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Divination](/Traits.aspx?ID=47), [Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** By concentrating their psychic energy on a held object, the munavri intuits its use and understands how to effectively wield it. The munavri chooses one item they're holding. They gain the trained proficiency rank in one statistic required to use that item, but only for the purpose of using that specific item. For example, they could become trained in [greatswords](/Weapons.aspx?ID=24) (to use a specific greatsword) or [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) (to use a [_jade cat talisman_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1671)). This benefit lasts for 1 hour.

</column>
